description: Gemaal is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.aaenmaas.nl. In principle, a pumping station serves to bring water from a low level to a high level, the need of which may lie in excess water on the low side (discharge) or in water requirements in the area on the high side (feeding). source: Aquo. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Pumping station" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
